scripts.test: npm run bddgen && mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts
scripts.test:android: PLATFORM=android npm run bddgen && PLATFORM=android mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --project=android
scripts.test:conveyor-poc: PLATFORM=android npm run bddgen && PLATFORM=android mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --project=android --grep @conveyorpoc
scripts.test:login: PLATFORM=android npm run bddgen && PLATFORM=android mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --project=android --grep @login
scripts.test:login-smoke: PLATFORM=android npm run bddgen && PLATFORM=android mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --project=android --grep "@login.*@smoke|@smoke.*@login"
scripts.test:login-regression: PLATFORM=android npm run bddgen && PLATFORM=android mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --project=android --grep "@login.*@regression|@regression.*@login"
scripts.test:run-mobile-tc: PLATFORM=android npm run bddgen && PLATFORM=android mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --project=android --grep @runThis1
scripts.test:ios: PLATFORM=ios npm run bddgen && PLATFORM=ios mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --project=ios
scripts.test:tag: npm run bddgen && mobilewright test --config config/mobilewright.config.ts --grep
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:results && npm run clean:features
